$comment: Stardust environmental methodology, versioned configuration (§8.4). Every number here is a swappable input, not a code constant. Entries marked needs_verification are placeholders pending board/technical review and must not be presented as authoritative.

model_tiers.$comment: MTR (§21.2). Patterns are case-insensitive regexes over the model name, checked in order; the first match wins. Size words must be whole name segments (so "gemini" is not "mini").
model_tiers.unknown_tier_note: Model not identifiable: use the most conservative factor set and tag the result Estimated (§8.3).

token_energy_wh.$comment: Modeled tier (§8.2). Output-token figures anchored so ~500 output tokens on a frontier model ≈ 0.3 Wh, the Oviedo et al. (2026) median of 0.31 Wh/query and the Epoch AI (2025) ≈0.3 Wh estimate. Input-token figure anchored to the spec's derived scaling (≈2.5 Wh for 10k input tokens, §8.7.1.1). Mid/small tiers are scaled down within Epoch AI's 0.0001–0.002 Wh/token range.
citations: Oviedo, F. et al. Joule (2026), arXiv:2509.20241
You, J. Epoch AI, Gradient Updates (2025)

estimated_per_query_wh.$comment: Estimated tier (§8.3) floor when no token counts are available at all.
estimated_per_query_wh.citation: Oviedo, F. et al. Joule (2026), arXiv:2509.20241 — frontier median

grids.$comment: Static annual-average grid factors (§8.5). The live path (§8.6) replaces these with Electricity Maps / WattTime values at the job timestamp and falls back here when the feed is unavailable. Mix keys are ESCs; coal has no ESC yet (§5.3.1) so it is recorded as FPP.

global.citation: Ember, Global Electricity Review 2024 (2023 world average)

US.citation: U.S. EIA, 2023 net generation by source and CO2 per kWh

SE.citation: Approximate 2023 Swedish generation mix — replace with Electricity Maps

FR.citation: Approximate 2023 French generation mix (RTE) — replace with Electricity Maps

region_to_grid.$comment: Cloud region (OTel cloud.region) → grid key. Regexes checked in order; unmatched regions use "global".

provider_default_grid.$comment: Used when the event has no region. Hyperscaler AI inference is predominantly US-hosted today; this is an assumption, not a measurement.

onsite_wue_l_per_kwh.citation: Shehabi, A. et al. United States Data Center Energy Usage Report, LBNL (2016)

generation_l_per_kwh.citation: U.S. average EWIF as used in Li, P. et al. "Making AI Less 'Thirsty'" (2023)

indicator.$comment: §5.1 thresholds. Placeholder static cut-offs until a rolling benchmark exists (§19). Each list is [upper bound, value] checked in order; the last entry catches everything above.

right_sizing.$comment: §21.4 default weights, not yet consumed by code.
